B0_scope: Only old-data audit and interfaces. This protocol does not authorize opening training before its data gate passes.

labels.A: Physical professional anomaly at exact endpoint, including short runs; retained>=15s event membership separate.
labels.B_reference: A and calibrated qualified measurement alarm, conditional on completion.
labels.B_action_primary: B_reference where root-known qualified Tour or one-CHECK-then-Tour completion exists at exact endpoint; otherwise missing -1.
labels.C: Independent future B4-C whole-episode miss/delay/cost labels; never a predictor feature or A/B target.
labels.validity: Endpoint<=1800, exact5s grid, source clock<=root, role/access/timing/complete-return qualification; illegal is not a negative.

old_data_policy: 8500-8703 and all earlier data are diagnostic/development material only; never final independent test. No time/noise/event random split or test oversampling.
split_assignment: A seed and all its scenarios/phases/noise versions remain in one split. Identical numeric process fingerprints across splits are a hard stop requiring an amended protocol before training, never relabelled independent.

new_process_plan.observer_controller: Original protected Tour with frozen CVAE and original calibrated measurements. Same old plant parameters, no score/policy optimization.
new_process_plan.no_more_samples_rule: Generate exactly this manifest once; failed correctness jobs may be repaired/versioned, no fault strengthening, seed replacement, event copying, resampling or append-until-positive.

data_gate.readiness: All claimed kind/horizon cells need enough valid B_action positives and negatives before model selection; endpoint A/B_reference separately reported. Generation not yet executed means coverage unverified and no training GO.
data_gate.failure: Stop model search for failing cells; report exact deficits. Limited domain requires explicit declared subset and separate claim, not pooled all-task success.

features.topology: Public same-Pod/CDU/power branch identifiers only; no hidden fault topology.
features.preprocessing: Fit value scaling and any imputation on development only; missing masks retained; no class oversampling, class balancing or seed/scenario feature. Process/noise conditions uniformly weighted within seed group.

empirical_frequency.definition: Development per-profession/horizon Laplace smoothed event-frequency probability on valid samples; fixed alpha=1,beta=1

logistic_regression.optimizer: deterministic full-batch or fixed-order streaming convex solver
logistic_regression.heads: 2labels x4professions x3horizons; choose using validation_selection process-mean Brier, tie strongerL2

bounded_trend.definition: Original bounded history extrapolation at horizon for thermal; original professional held evidence for other roles. Calibrate scalar, no new coefficients.

nominal_physical.definition: Root causal nominal temperature held at endpoint for thermal; explicit professional evidence baseline for nonthermal. No future simulator rollforward or hidden faults.

frozen_CVAE_raw.definition: Root raw CVAE prior output held; raw and assimilated separate. Thermal-only model claim; other professions get explicit unavailable, not fake CVAE estimates.

frozen_CVAE_assimilated.definition: Separate ablation/representation baseline using the root measurement-overwritten cache, held to endpoint; not another trained estimator.

optional_small_temporal.design: One-layer GRU width16 on last3 qualified/readout states with timestamps and missingness. Activate only via separately frozen amendment; not a rescue candidate after test.

calibration.method: Fixed ridge Platt/logistic sigmoid on validation_calibration only; score scaling constants development only; ridge=1, max_iterations=200.
calibration.applies: Each scalar family, label, profession and horizon that is available. Logistic heads receive same fixed sigmoid calibration; empirical frequency constant remains its development probability.
calibration.degenerate_cell: No independent positives/negatives means data gate fails, not a manufactured calibration curve.
calibration.threshold: Validation_selection negatives only: smallest score threshold with empirical FPR<=0.01, strict score>threshold and ties conservatively rejected. Threshold fixed before test; no test tuning.

primary: Event-level recall at fixed1% validation FPR budget on B_action, retained>=15s events with at least one valid sample
secondary: Test FPR and false alarms per1800s/valid opportunity
Event eligibility denominator and unforecastable events
metrics.event_recall: A retained event counts once per numeric physical trajectory; noise versions averaged within process then seed. A sample predicts its completion-bin event, not a future window chosen after truth. Raw short events secondary.
metrics.uncertainty: 2000 paired bootstrap resamples of independent seed groups, seed770030 fixed; recompute macro metrics including noise/scenario/phase together. Report95%percentileCI, raw n seeds and event/process counts; no row bootstrap or significance from millions of timestamps.

test_seal: All model, calibrator, hyperparameter and threshold SHA receipts frozen after validation. Only then expose final test scores/metrics once; no seed or candidate replacement.

GO_NO_GO.GO: Every prespecified cell passes data gate; selected predictive family increases eligible-event recall >=0.05 absolute over best fixed nonlearned baseline and reduces macro Brier >=5% relative; paired95%CI excludes no-improvement for both; test FPR<=0.02 overall and<=0.05 per seed with>=100 negatives; no profession loses>0.05 recall. Gains need unique information attribution, not raw-CVAE label by presence.
GO_NO_GO.LIMITED_GO: All full-domain GO gates fail but a prespecified profession/horizon cell passes the same effect/FPR/data rules with positive paired95%CI, reported as limited with multiplicity Holm correction across12cells; no test-defined new subgroup.
GO_NO_GO.NO_GO: Data/causality gate failure, absent reliable incremental prediction, or materially higher false alarms. Preserve results and investigate sensors/objective; no automatic policy expansion.
GO_NO_GO.B0_GO: Data interface and causality verified AND fresh process-level independent positive/negative coverage empirically satisfies gate. An ungenerated new manifest never meets this gate.

Slurm_phases: source/seed-manifest freeze and full test gate
bounded development+validation data generation and label audit
coverage gate -> fits on development only
freeze all artifacts -> one final test scoring

licensing_and_site_scope: Synthetic calibrated-in-model measurements, no site calibration or real risk probability claim. Existing model weights stay private with SHA.
